identification: Large A-frame champagne riddling rack (pupitre), French oak, two hinged boards of about 120 angled bottle holes, chain stay. Weathered, no maker stamp seen.

entries.note: Modern French oak wine rack, 85x93 cm. Not a riddling rack. Paid locally: what we might pay for a plain oak rack, not a resale price. Database record only.

searches_tried: pipeline/comps.py: riddling rack; pupitre; champagne riddling; french oak rack; oak wine rack; wine rack. work/comps.py: riddling rack; champagne. No same-item hits in any database.
chrome_hint: eBay AU and eBay.com sold listings (Terapeak): 'French oak riddling rack', 'pupitre champagne riddling rack antique', 'riddling rack wine'; filter Sold, last 12 months, note shipping/pickup. Also Pickles/Lawsons/Leonard Joel/Theodore Bruce and 1stDibs/Chairish results for 'antique French pupitre'; live asking prices on Gumtree, Facebook Marketplace and decor dealers (ASKING only). Note size, 60 vs 120 hole, hinged condition, and whether sold as decor or reproduction.
viewing_check: Check for original French oak grain and age (hand-cut holes, wear inside holes, wooden pegs vs screws), any chalk numbers or stencil/brand marks, hinge and chain condition, splits through the boards, stability when opened, and measure height and width. Photograph the inside of the holes and the underside of the boards.
